lease.message:
coordination: release generation-76 lock for claude-newghostpay-e3; PR #758 merged as fd5e591151765b2dafe6345501ca40393e0f176a; main fd5e5911

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
lease.note: unchanged if exact ref matches prior

checks.name: beta acceptance (lib + cli + browser on anvil)
Release gates (typecheck, lint, unit, mocked lean browser suite)
Build and verify the Pages site

prior.verification: Both complete reports downloaded and SHA-256 verified with Python stdlib; parsed five JSON results per report; multiset comparison of contract/function/SWC/severity/bytecode PC/sourceMap/line/code and normalized filename: 10 of 11 finding identities identical, 8 Low and 3 Medium in each. Current-only SWC-113 Low PolicyAccountFactory.deploy line 117 / PC 999 / sourceMap 6237:81:26::1 (initialize call); old-only SWC-113 Low line 132 / PC 1781 (allowance). Absence is not resolution. No new Medium identity. Source and vendored lib trees identical to baseline; compiler config and remappings unchanged, runner changed since baseline; compatibility wrapper identical. Flagged three contract blobs and runner byte-identical to immediate previous main.
prior.review: Source shows nonReentrant deployment; fixed implementation clone initialization follows fee collection and CREATE2. Existing tests cover rollback, guard held during initialization, call order and absence of external calls below clone. Relevant evidence, not fresh test execution or final finding-specific disposition. Preserve documented fee-token failure residual. Prior dispositions do not specifically cover new SWC-113 identity and do not authorize suppression. No blind rerun or weakened gate.

mythrilReconciliation.note: Current log confirms analyzer exit 1; current finding identities not yet independently compared; prior finding-specific disposition remains open.

sourceReview.disposition: New draft: isolated claim, 14 test instances by static count, donor disposition handoff. Three changed files verified by GitHub diff. Queued/running hosted checks, native tests not executed by this worker. Independent review and ownership clearance required before merge.

sourceReview.disposition: 14 residual test cases reported by existing comment 7202316908; Bitcoin is excluded from lean EVM beta, no feature development. Preserve branch and evaluate existing containment test separately; no work assigned.

ownerScope: All ten exclusions binding; P14 and shared core preserved. #659 merged. #614 mixed held. #636 held, frozen ref unchanged, source divergence previously recorded; no F04 authorization.
next: Resolve current Mythril finding with independent finding-specific disposition, no gate weakening.
Qualify #761 exact head, check hosted test logs and request independent review; preserve original #300 until disposition. No production code modifications.
#759 qualified on exact PR head; existing owner to coordinate applicable gates and lease. #742/#753/#665 remain owned; #726 docs-only.
limitations: Paginated non-atomic snapshot, no exhaustive semantic classification or global unresolved count proven. Relevant open-PR file scan hit connector per-invocation limit; new #761 only claims new paths with #760's explicit unassigned finding and separate #742 files; full fresh path clearance remains before integration.
No local full checkout, native tests, independent final review or merge by this worker. Branch protection read denied 403, no bypass.
